research.title: Taxonomy note
research.notes: Partial derivatives, chain rule, gradients, Hessians, integration, Taylor expansions and ODEs belong under calculus. Vectors, matrix products, SVD and definiteness belong under linear algebra. Jacobians connect calculus and linear algebra; rigid transforms connect geometry and linear algebra. Use one primary category plus typed cross-links rather than duplicate nodes.

research.method: Downloaded seven URDF XML files from manufacturer-owned GitHub repositories at pinned tree commits; parsed joint types, mimic/transmission/control tags, roots, link masses, limit samples and inertia eigenvalues. No meshes were copied.

Read official URDF parser source, ROS REP-103, MoveIt URDF/SRDF, ros2_control documentation and MuJoCo modeling/computation documentation. ROS hosted tutorial pages returned an access challenge; official source and alternate primary docs were used.

ROS REP-103: SI units and coordinate conventions
MoveIt: URDF and SRDF, virtual and passive joints
ros2_control hardware interfaces and URDF tags
MuJoCo model computation: free-joint positions and velocities
MuJoCo modeling: URDF import, compilation and model differences

nodes.title: 函数与复合函数
nodes.summary: 把一套输入转成输出的规则，是模型最基础的语言。
nodes.explain:
从高中函数 y=2x+1 开始：输入 x=3，先乘二再加一，输出七。机器学习把这个规则推广为许多输入和许多输出，例如输入物体位置、速度和推动方向，输出下一刻位置。变量是会改变的量；参数是规则本身的旋钮，例如二和一。训练时调整旋钮，推理时给规则新的输入。复合函数表示规则接力：先用 g 把相机图片转成特征，再用 f 把特征与动作转成下一步特征。先写清每个盒子的输入、输出和单位，再读复杂论文，就能避免把状态、动作和模型参数混为一谈。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: x：输入；y：输出；θ：模型参数；∘：先执行右边再执行左边。
nodes.role: 直接基础：ID-WM 的编码器、低层预测器和高层去噪器都可以先看成不同的函数。
nodes.pitfall: 输入变量与网络参数的角色不同；有一条公式并不代表函数已知或已学会。
nodes.quiz: 若 g(x)=x+1，f(x)=2x，f(g(3)) 是多少？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Composition: apply g first, then f.

nodes.definition: A function assigns one output to each allowed input. A parameterized function changes when its parameters change; an input variable changes which output is evaluated for a fixed function. Composition applies one function to the output of another, provided the output and input domains are compatible. Neural networks, observation encoders, and dynamics predictors can all be described as functions, even when their inputs and outputs are vectors rather than single numbers.
nodes.example: Let \(g(x)=2x+1\) and \(f(u)=u^2\). For \(x=3\), the intermediate value is \(g(3)=7\), and the composed result is \(f(g(3))=49\). Reversing the order gives \(g(f(3))=19\), so composition is generally order-dependent. In a prediction pipeline, encoding an image before predicting a future representation is also an ordered composition. A composition is defined only when the intermediate output is a valid input to the next function.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM composes an observation representation with learned transition functions and a planner. Distinguishing model parameters from current inputs also separates training, which changes parameters, from inference, which evaluates trained functions and searches decision variables.

nodes.title: 向量
nodes.summary: 把多个有固定含义的数按顺序放在一起。
nodes.explain:
平面位置写成 (x,y)，它是一个二维向量。若再加入水平速度和竖直速度，可写 s=(x,y,vx,vy)，这是四维状态向量，虽然物体仍在二维平面运动。维数是记录了多少个数，不是现实世界有多少空间方向。向量相加逐项相加，例如位置 (1,2) 加位移 (3,−1) 得 (4,1)。乘一个标量则所有分量都乘它。做机器人模型时，顺序必须固定；若训练时第一项是角度、部署时第一项换成角速度，网络不会自动理解。还要记录米、秒、弧度等单位，避免数值看似接近却语义不同。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: ᵀ：转置为列；n：分量数；aᵢ：第 i 个分量。
nodes.role: 直接基础：状态、动作、子目标和扩散噪声都以向量或张量记录。
nodes.pitfall: 四维状态不意味着物体生活在四维空间。
nodes.quiz: 二维位置和二维速度拼接后，状态是多少维？
nodes.answer: 四维：两个位置分量加两个速度分量。

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: An ordered vector of state features.
Transpose, converting the displayed row to a column.

nodes.definition: A real vector is an ordered collection of real-valued components. Its dimension is the number of components, and each position must retain a consistent meaning. Vectors of the same dimension can be added component by component and multiplied by scalars. In engineering, dimensions alone do not establish compatibility: units, reference frames, and feature order must also agree. A state vector can contain positions, velocities, angles, or learned features.
nodes.example: For a planar moving object, write \(\mathbf{s}=[1,2,0.5,-1]^{\mathsf T}\), with positions measured in metres and velocities in metres per second. The third component denotes horizontal velocity, not another position. Exchanging the second and third components preserves the vector shape but changes its physical meaning, so a model trained with the original order would receive incorrect inputs.
nodes.role_en: Both ID-WM levels operate on state or representation vectors. Vector definitions establish what enters each model, which quantities are predicted, and how candidate future states can be compared with a goal.

nodes.title: 矩阵与形状
nodes.summary: 矩阵既能排列数据，也能表示线性变换。
nodes.explain:
把三个样本各自的四维状态按行堆起来，得到 3×4 的矩阵。这里三是样本数，四是特征数。另一个用途是变换：用一个矩阵把四个输入混合成六个输出。两种用途都叫矩阵，但行列含义由上下文决定。读神经网络代码时先写形状，例如 X∈R^(B×d)，可以提前发现很多错误：B 是一批有多少样本，d 是每个样本有多少特征。矩阵里的数没有自带语义，需要同时保留列名、坐标系与单位。图像还会有高度、宽度和颜色通道，推广后称为张量。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: R：实数；B：批量大小；d：输入维数；k：输出维数。
nodes.role: 直接基础：理解低层 Transformer 的 token 批次及高层轨迹数组。
nodes.pitfall: 同样是 3×4，可能是三样本四特征，也可能是三维点的四列坐标；要看定义。
nodes.quiz: 一批 32 个样本，每个含 10 个状态数，矩阵形状是什么？
nodes.answer: 按样本在行的约定，为 32×10。

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Number of examples in a batch.
Number of input features per example.
Entry in row i and column j.

nodes.definition: A matrix is a rectangular array with a specified number of rows and columns. It may represent a batch of examples, a linear transformation, or a covariance structure. Its shape determines which operations are defined but does not by itself describe the meaning of its entries. Writing dimensions alongside equations helps detect incompatible operations before implementation and makes the batch, time, and feature axes of neural-network inputs explicit.
nodes.example: Suppose a batch contains four states with three features each. Its matrix has shape \(4\times3\). Multiplying by a weight matrix with shape \(3\times2\) gives four outputs with two features each, a \(4\times2\) result. A \(4\times2\) weight matrix cannot be substituted into the same ordinary matrix product because the inner dimensions would disagree.
nodes.role_en: Matrix shapes are essential for the low-level predictor, action encoder, Transformer projections, and batched CEM candidate evaluation. The same mathematical model can fail in code if batch and feature axes are exchanged.

nodes.title: 点积与矩阵乘法
nodes.summary: 用加权求和把输入组合成输出。
nodes.explain:
两个向量做点积，就是对应项相乘后相加。例子：输入 x=(2,3)，权重 w=(4,−1)，点积为 2×4+3×(−1)=5。一个输出就是这样一个加权和；许多输出并排放在一起，就得到矩阵乘法。若 X 有 B 行 d 列，W 有 d 行 k 列，XW 就有 B 行 k 列；中间的 d 必须相同，因为每个输出都要累加 d 对乘积。这是全连接层的核心计算，也是注意力计算相似度的基础。乘法顺序通常不能互换：先旋转再平移，与先平移再旋转，会产生不同结果。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: ·：点积；Σ：求和；i,j,k：位置索引。
nodes.role: 直接基础：神经网络线性层、注意力中的 QKᵀ，以及特征预测。
nodes.pitfall: 矩阵乘法不是对应位置相乘；AB 通常不等于 BA。

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Shared dimension over which the product sums.
Output row and output column indices.

nodes.definition: The dot product multiplies corresponding vector components and sums the products. Matrix multiplication computes one dot product for each output entry: a row of the first matrix is paired with a column of the second. This combines input features into outputs and composes linear transformations. It differs from elementwise multiplication, and its order generally matters. A valid product requires the first matrix column count to equal the second matrix row count.
nodes.example: For \(\mathbf{x}=[1,2]^{\mathsf T}\) and \(\mathbf{w}=[3,4]^{\mathsf T}\), the dot product is \(1\cdot3+2\cdot4=11\). If two weight columns are \([3,4]^{\mathsf T}\) and \([1,-1]^{\mathsf T}\), the row input \([1,2]\) produces \([11,-1]\). The two output features are separate weighted combinations of the same inputs. The feature count is preserved at the input but need not equal the output count; the weight columns determine it.
nodes.role_en: Matrix multiplication implements fully connected layers and the query, key, and value projections used by the low-level Transformer. Dot products also determine attention scores, connecting elementary linear algebra to the predictor architecture.

nodes.title: 范数与距离
nodes.summary: 把一个多维误差变成可以比较的单个数字。
nodes.explain:
比较预测位置 (4,5) 和目标位置 (1,1)，误差向量为 (3,4)。欧氏距离沿直线量长度，得到五；平方距离得到二十五。L1 距离则把各方向绝对值相加，得到七。它们对应不同惩罚方式，不能随意替换。机器人状态还可能把位置、角度和速度混在一起：一米和一弧度不能因为数字相同就认为影响相同，需要归一化或权重。世界模型预测误差和规划目标距离都常写成范数；理解它首先要问比较的是哪一种状态、在哪个坐标系、各分量是否有相同尺度。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: e：误差向量；下标 1、2：范数类型。
nodes.role: 直接基础：低层模型拟合误差、子目标距离与规划代价。
nodes.pitfall: 平方距离和距离不相同；混合单位的状态距离需要设计。
nodes.quiz: 误差为 (3,4)，L2 范数与其平方各是多少？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

nodes.definition: A norm assigns a nonnegative magnitude to a vector and satisfies definiteness, homogeneity, and the triangle inequality. The Euclidean norm is the straight-line length in ordinary coordinates. Applying a norm to the difference between two vectors defines a distance. The squared Euclidean norm is often useful as a loss, although it is not itself a norm. Feature units and scaling influence the interpretation of all such numerical distances.
nodes.example: If a predicted two-dimensional position differs from its target by \(\mathbf{e}=[3,4]^{\mathsf T}\) centimetres, its Euclidean error is \(5\) centimetres, its squared error is \(25\) squared centimetres, and its L1 error is \(7\) centimetres. Adding an angular component without choosing a scale changes the meaning of the score and requires an explicit modelling decision.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM uses distances between predicted states and goals to score planning candidates. The low-level paper equation uses an L2 norm, while generic MSE uses its square; these related objectives should not be reported as identical formulas.

nodes.title: 坐标系与坐标变换
nodes.summary: 同一个物体，在不同参考系里可以有不同坐标。
nodes.explain:
你站在球的左边，说球在右侧；机器人转身以后，它自己的右侧会改变，但球在房间中的位置可以完全不变。这说明坐标必须同时注明参考系。二维旋转矩阵用角度把一个坐标系中的分量转为另一个；再加平移，就能描述两个坐标原点不同。公式里的矩阵到底把 A 系变成 B 系，必须用明确定义判断。做规划时若目标在世界坐标，模型输出却在机器人局部坐标，直接相减会造成错误。坐标变换是机器人扩展分支，对状态式 PushT 的最低理解门槛较低，但对真实机器人实现非常关键。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: pᴬ：A 系坐标；Rᴬ_B：B 到 A 的旋转；tᴬ_B：B 原点在 A 系的位置。
nodes.role: 机器人工程扩展：正确表示观测、动作和目标；不是 ID-WM 独有算法。
nodes.pitfall: 坐标系变换与物体真的移动是两件事。
nodes.quiz: 机器人原地转身，球在世界坐标一定改变吗？
nodes.answer: 不一定；世界中的球可以静止，机器人坐标中的球位置会变化。

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Coordinates of the same point in frames A and B.
Rotation mapping B-frame vector coordinates into frame A.
Position of the B-frame origin expressed in frame A.

nodes.definition: A coordinate system specifies an origin and basis directions for expressing geometric quantities. A rigid transformation changes a point representation between frames using a rotation and a translation. The point can remain physically fixed while its coordinate values change. Correct notation must identify both the source and destination frames. Rotating a direction vector requires only the rotation; transforming a point generally also requires translation because the origins may differ.
nodes.example: Rotate the planar point \([1,0]^{\mathsf T}\) by \(90^\circ\) about the origin. The rotation matrix maps it to \([0,1]^{\mathsf T}\). If the destination frame translation is then \([2,3]^{\mathsf T}\), the transformed point is \([2,4]^{\mathsf T}\). Applying translation before rotation would in general produce a different result and describe a different transformation.
nodes.role_en: Coordinate consistency matters when constructing state inputs, goal errors, or robot extensions. ID-WM state-based experiments require consistent geometric labels; transferring the method to a robot additionally requires explicit world, body, sensor, and joint conventions.

nodes.title: 角度与三角表示
nodes.summary: 角度有首尾相接的结构，不能总按普通数字做差。
nodes.explain:
指南针朝向 179° 与 −179°，实际只差 2°，普通减法却得到 358°。这类跳变会让网络把几乎相同的朝向当成完全不同。可以把角度写成 (cosθ,sinθ)，让圆周上的邻近方向在数值上也邻近。这个表示增加一个分量，但保留了周期结构。角速度仍需分清单位：一圈是 360°，也是 2π 弧度，微积分公式通常使用弧度。姿态推广到三维时还有旋转矩阵和四元数，需要另外学习；先理解二维圆周，就能看懂为什么许多机器人模型不会直接回归一个未经处理的角度值。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: θ：角度；rad：弧度；π：圆周率。
nodes.role: 机器人扩展与状态设计基础：避免旋转状态的错误距离和训练目标。
nodes.pitfall: 角度跨越 ±π 的边界时，普通差值不等于最短角差。
nodes.quiz: 179° 与 −179° 的最短夹角是多少？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Angle, usually in radians in mathematical software.

nodes.definition: Trigonometric functions relate angles to coordinates on the unit circle. Sine and cosine are periodic, so they represent orientation without an artificial numerical break at a full revolution. Angles expressed directly in a bounded interval can have large numerical differences near the interval boundary even when the physical orientations are close. A sine-cosine pair avoids that particular discontinuity, although it uses two coordinates subject to a unit-length constraint.
nodes.example: The angles \(179^\circ\) and \(-179^\circ\) differ by only \(2^\circ\) around the circle, but ordinary subtraction gives \(358^\circ\). Their sine-cosine representations are close instead. For \(\theta=\pi/2\), the representation is \([0,1]^{\mathsf T}\). Always convert degrees to radians before calling software functions whose arguments use radians. The representation uses periodicity rather than treating a full revolution as a distinct physical orientation.
nodes.role_en: Angle representations affect state distances, rotations, and prediction targets in manipulation and robotics. Trigonometric features also provide mathematical background for sinusoidal positional encoding, but their use in a state representation must be chosen and verified explicitly.

nodes.title: 导数
nodes.summary: 导数告诉你输入稍微改变时，输出往哪变、变多快。
nodes.explain:
车的位置随时间变化，速度就是位置的变化率。若位置为 x(t)=t²，t=3 时斜率为六：时间非常小地增加 Δt，位置大约增加 6Δt。这个近似是局部的，不能把很大的时间变化也当成精确直线。机器学习把同样思想用于参数：某个权重稍微增大，损失会增加还是减少？导数提供方向信息。它不是模型效果本身，而是调整模型的工具。先用曲线的切线理解，再学习求导法则，读损失优化就会有具体画面。折线函数有拐点时需要讨论可导性，实际深度学习框架会选用约定的梯度。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: h、Δx：很小的输入变化；f′：导数。
nodes.role: 直接基础：理解模型训练和扩散相关可微计算；CEM 本身不要求代价可导。
nodes.pitfall: 局部线性近似只在足够小的范围有意义。
nodes.quiz: f(x)=x²，在 x=3 时导数是多少？
nodes.answer: f′(x)=2x，所以是 6。

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Derivative at x, when the limit exists.

nodes.definition: The derivative of a scalar function at a point is the limit of its difference quotient, when that limit exists. It measures the local rate of output change with respect to the input. A derivative gives a first-order approximation near the point, rather than a guarantee about large changes. A function can be differentiable on some parts of its domain and nondifferentiable at others, which matters when composing optimization objectives.
nodes.example: For \(f(x)=x^2\), the derivative is \(f\prime(x)=2x\). At \(x=3\), increasing the input by \(0.01\) gives the first-order prediction \(9+6(0.01)=9.06\). The exact result is \(3.01^2=9.0601\). Their difference is the second-order term \(0.01^2\), illustrating why a sufficiently small increment improves the local approximation. This approximation concerns the chosen point; a derivative evaluated elsewhere would give a different local rate.
nodes.role_en: Derivatives lead to partial derivatives, gradients, and backpropagation for training ID-WM networks. They are background for learning the models; the paper uses CEM rather than requiring derivatives of its planning objective with respect to candidate decisions.

nodes.title: 偏导数
nodes.summary: 多输入函数里，固定其他输入，只研究一个输入的影响。
nodes.explain:
若房间温度由加热功率和窗户开度共同决定，你可以先固定窗户，只调整功率，观察温度变化；这就是偏导的思想。函数 L(w₁,w₂)=w₁²+3w₂²，对 w₁ 的偏导是 2w₁，对 w₂ 的偏导是 6w₂。这里比较的是不同参数的局部影响。神经网络可能有数百万个权重，每个权重都需要对应的偏导。固定其他变量是一种数学操作，不表示训练时只能更新一个参数。还要区分对输入求导与对参数求导：前者可用于解释或规划，后者用于训练，问题不同。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: ∂：多变量函数的偏导符号；L：损失；w：参数。
nodes.role: 直接基础：把一个预测误差分配给许多网络参数。
nodes.pitfall: 偏导必须写明“对谁求导”；对动作的梯度与对模型参数的梯度不同。
nodes.quiz: L=x²+3y²，对 y 求偏导是什么？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Increment applied only to coordinate j.

nodes.definition: A partial derivative measures the local rate of change of a multivariable function with respect to one input coordinate while holding the other coordinates fixed. It is an ordinary one-variable derivative applied to the function obtained by fixing those other inputs. Partial derivatives provide individual components of the gradient. Their existence alone does not always establish full differentiability, so first-order vector approximations require appropriate regularity assumptions.
nodes.example: Let \(L(w_1,w_2)=w_1^2+3w_2^2\). Differentiating with respect to \(w_1\) while keeping \(w_2\) fixed gives \(2w_1\); differentiating with respect to \(w_2\) gives \(6w_2\). At \((1,2)\), the two partial derivatives are \(2\) and \(12\). They describe different coordinate directions at the same input point. Changing both inputs at once requires combining their partial derivatives with the corresponding increments; one partial derivative alone does not describe that joint change.
nodes.role_en: Each ID-WM network parameter has a partial derivative of the training loss. Backpropagation calculates these derivatives efficiently, and the optimizer combines them into a parameter update. This definition also supports Jacobians of vector-valued state predictors.
nodes.title_original: 偏导数：一次只动一个旋钮

nodes.title: 链式法则
nodes.summary: 把很多简单步骤串起来后，整体导数可以沿路径相乘。
nodes.explain:
设先把 x 平方得到 u，再把 u 乘三得到 y。x 的改变先影响 u，再影响 y，所以 dy/dx=(dy/du)(du/dx)=3×2x。网络由线性层、激活和损失等许多简单步骤组成，计算图把它们画成依赖网络。沿一条路径，局部影响相乘；若有多条路径通向输出，贡献相加。这是反向传播的数学基础。图中箭头表示计算依赖，和学习知识图谱里的“先修”箭头含义不同。先做一个手算例子，再看自动微分，可以理解框架究竟帮我们自动完成了什么。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: u：中间结果；d：一元导数；计算图节点：具体运算。
nodes.role: 直接基础：训练低层 Transformer 和高层去噪网络的反向传播。
nodes.pitfall: 链式法则是数学规则；反向传播是高效利用它的计算过程。
nodes.quiz: y=3x²，在 x=2 时 dy/dx 是多少？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

notation.meaning: Product of local derivatives along the composition.

nodes.definition: The chain rule differentiates a composition by multiplying derivatives of its component functions in the appropriate order. For multivariable functions, contributions from multiple computational paths must be summed, and Jacobian products replace scalar multiplication. A computational graph records which values depend on which earlier values. Reverse-mode automatic differentiation traverses that graph backward, accumulating the contributions needed to differentiate a scalar loss with respect to many parameters.
nodes.example: Let \(u=2x+1\) and \(y=u^2\). Then \(dy/du=2u\) and \(du/dx=2\), so \(dy/dx=4(2x+1)\). At \(x=3\), the derivative is \(28\). Directly expanding \(y=4x^2+4x+1\) gives the same result. Both calculations differentiate the same ordered composition. The factor associated with each operation is evaluated at its own intermediate input, so omitting the intermediate value would make the derivative incorrect.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM training propagates loss derivatives through encoders, Transformer operations, and denoising networks. The chain rule explains these computations and why detaching a tensor interrupts gradient propagation through the corresponding computational path.

nodes.title: 梯度与梯度下降
nodes.summary: 梯度收集所有参数方向的斜率，下降法朝局部减小损失的方向走。
nodes.explain:
站在山坡上，梯度指向局部上升最快的方向；取反方向可以尝试下坡。若损失 L(w)=(w−3)²，w=0 时梯度为 −6，用学习率 0.1 更新后 w=0−0.1×(−6)=0.6，比原来靠近三。学习率决定步子大小：太大可能越过低谷甚至发散，太小则训练很慢。多参数网络只是把一个导数换成梯度向量。非凸山地可能有许多谷底，下降过程并不保证找到全局最优。世界模型训练在优化网络参数；规划阶段通常优化候选动作或噪声，两种“优化”不要混在一起。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: η：学习率；∇：梯度；θ：待优化参数。
nodes.role: 直接基础：理解训练；ID-WM 规划使用 CEM，不能把它直接说成梯度下降。
nodes.pitfall: 梯度下降的训练步骤与 CEM 的采样筛选是不同算法。
nodes.quiz: w=0，L=(w−3)²，学习率0.1，更新一次得到什么？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

nodes.definition: The gradient collects the partial derivatives of a scalar function into a vector. Under the Euclidean inner product, its direction gives the steepest first-order increase per unit displacement. Gradient descent updates parameters in the negative-gradient direction to seek lower loss. The local direction does not guarantee a global minimum or a decrease for every step size. Parameter scaling, curvature, stochastic gradients, and learning-rate choices all affect the optimization process.
nodes.example: For \(L(w)=w^2\), start at \(w=3\) with learning rate \(\eta=0.1\). The derivative is \(6\), so the update gives \(w=2.4\), lowering the loss from \(9\) to \(5.76\). With a sufficiently large learning rate, the same negative-gradient update can overshoot and increase the loss instead of reducing it. The example uses an exact gradient; minibatch training instead estimates a gradient from sampled examples.
nodes.role_en: Gradients train the high-level denoising model and low-level dynamics predictor from offline data. ID-WM inference searches noise and action sequences with CEM, so training-gradient updates and inference-time search are separate operations.

nodes.title: 雅可比矩阵
nodes.summary: 向量输出对向量输入的全部一阶影响组成矩阵。
nodes.explain:
若输入是二维动作，输出是二维位置，每一个动作分量都可能影响每一个位置分量。把这四个偏导排成 2×2 矩阵，就是雅可比。它像局部的动作说明书：动作小幅改变 Δa，下一步位置约改变 JΔa。注意这个近似依赖当前状态，同一脚踢在不同接触姿态下会产生不同敏感度。在机器人学里，它还用于关节速度到末端速度的映射。理解雅可比有助于掌握可微动力学、梯度规划和反向传播的多维形式；ID-WM 的 CEM 规划不需要显式计算这个矩阵，因此应作为进一步理解的分支。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: J：雅可比；fᵢ：第 i 个输出；xⱼ：第 j 个输入。
nodes.role: 进阶扩展：连接机器人运动学、可微动力学与梯度规划；非 CEM 必需。
nodes.pitfall: 雅可比通常随当前位置改变；局部近似不能直接当全局动力学。
nodes.quiz: 三个输入、两个输出的雅可比形状是什么？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

nodes.definition: The Jacobian matrix contains the first partial derivative of every output coordinate with respect to every input coordinate. For a differentiable vector-valued function, it describes the best linear first-order approximation at a point. Its dimensions follow the output and input dimensions. A Jacobian can describe geometric sensitivity, neural-network input sensitivity, or state-transition sensitivity, but each interpretation must identify exactly which input and output variables are involved.
nodes.example: For \(f(x_1,x_2)=[x_1+x_2,\;x_1^2]^{\mathsf T}\), the Jacobian is \(J=[[1,1],[2x_1,0]]\). At \((2,3)\), increasing \(x_1\) by \(0.01\) gives the predicted output change \([0.01,0.04]^{\mathsf T}\). The exact second-coordinate change is \(0.0401\), again showing the difference between a local approximation and the full nonlinear update. The first output depends on both inputs, whereas the second output is locally insensitive to the second coordinate.
nodes.role_en: Jacobians are useful background for analyzing sensitivity and error propagation in learned dynamics. ID-WM does not require explicitly computing full Jacobian matrices for CEM planning, so this node is an analysis and robotics extension rather than a mandatory implementation step.
nodes.title_original: 雅可比矩阵与局部敏感度

nodes.title: 特征值与特征向量
nodes.summary: 寻找经过变换后只缩放、不改变直线方向的向量。
nodes.explain:
一块橡皮布被线性拉伸，有些方向会旋转，有些特殊方向只变长或变短。后一种方向是特征向量，缩放倍数是特征值。若矩阵把水平方向拉两倍、竖直方向拉三倍，这两个坐标轴就是特征方向。协方差矩阵的特征方向告诉我们数据在哪些组合方向上分散得最多，进而得到 PCA。不是每个实矩阵都有足够多的实特征向量，但实对称协方差矩阵具备良好的分解性质。读基础机器学习时先理解几何意义，再学习算法求解。这条分支用于表示分析与降维，不能因为 ID-WM 学习表示，就断言它内部一定执行 PCA。

学习时可先手算一个二维例子，再把每个量的形状和单位写在纸上；最后用几行数组运算核对结果。能复述名词还不够，能说明输入是什么、每一步为什么成立、输出如何解释，才适合继续连接上层算法。
nodes.symbols: A：方阵；v：特征向量；λ：特征值。
nodes.role: 扩展：支撑 PCA 和协方差理解；ID-WM 没有因此必须显式做特征分解。
nodes.pitfall: 特征向量的长度可改变；关键是方向。
nodes.quiz: A=diag(2,3)，向量 (1,0) 的特征值是多少？

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：线性代数、几何、微积分与优化

nodes.definition: An eigenvector of a square matrix is a nonzero vector whose transformed value is a scalar multiple of itself. The corresponding eigenvalue is that scalar. Real symmetric matrices admit an orthonormal eigenbasis with real eigenvalues, a property important for covariance matrices. Eigenvectors then identify independent directions associated with different variances. General matrices need not have a complete real eigenbasis, so this interpretation should not be applied without checking matrix properties.
nodes.example: For \(A=\operatorname{diag}(4,1)\), the horizontal unit vector is an eigenvector with eigenvalue \(4\), and the vertical unit vector has eigenvalue \(1\). If this is a covariance matrix, variation along the first direction is larger. PCA would retain that direction first when reducing the two-dimensional data to one principal coordinate. The variance interpretation follows from the covariance matrix, not from every possible square matrix.
nodes.role_en: Eigenvectors support the PCA and covariance-analysis branches of the atlas. They are useful for understanding representations and conditioning, but ID-WM does not train its visual representation by applying PCA to the observations.
nodes.title_original: 特征值、特征向量与主方向

nodes.title: 概率
nodes.summary: 用零到一之间的数描述事件发生的不确定性。
nodes.explain:
一次推动可能因为接触和测量噪声产生不同结果。概率不是“什么都不知道”，而是把不确定程度写清楚。若在一致条件下重复一百次，成功六十次，经验成功率是0.6；它是对真实成功概率的估计，不意味着下一次必然成功。事件可以是“球进入球门”或“预测误差小于阈值”。互斥且穷尽的结果概率相加为一，但两个能同时发生的事件不能直接按互斥相加。先明确重复实验条件和事件定义，再谈概率，才能防止把不同任务或不同难度的成功率混为一谈。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: P(A)：事件A概率；∪：至少一个；∩：同时发生。
nodes.role: 直接基础：世界模型分布、采样、成功率及扩散噪声。
nodes.pitfall: 观察到的频率带有样本不确定性；60/100不等于已知道精确概率。
nodes.quiz: 互斥事件概率0.2和0.3，至少一个发生的概率是多少？

notation.meaning: Sample space containing all possible outcomes.
Events, represented as sets of outcomes.

nodes.definition: Probability assigns a normalized measure to events in a specified sample space. An event is a set of outcomes, and its probability lies between zero and one. Probabilities of disjoint events add. Repeated-trial frequencies can estimate probabilities under suitable sampling assumptions, but an observed frequency is not the definition of every probability model. The experiment, possible outcomes, and event of interest must be specified before interpreting a probability numerically.
nodes.example: Roll a fair six-sided die. Let \(A\) be the event that the result is even, and \(B\) the event that it exceeds four. Then \(P(A)=3/6\), \(P(B)=2/6\), and \(P(A\cap B)=1/6\). Their union has probability \(4/6\), because the result six belongs to both events and must not be counted twice. The remaining two outcomes belong to neither event and complete the total probability to one.
nodes.role_en: Probability underlies the high-level conditional future-state distribution, Gaussian diffusion noise, and sampling in CEM. In ID-WM, it is used to model multiple possible local futures and to generate candidate decisions; it does not by itself certify that every generated state is physically reachable.

nodes.title: 随机变量与概率分布
nodes.summary: 随机变量把随机结果变成数；分布说明各类数值出现的可能性。
nodes.explain:
抛两枚硬币，随机变量 X 可以定义为正面数量，取值为零、一、二。分布给出每个取值的概率。位置等连续变量则用概率密度描述；某一个精确数值的概率通常为零，要讨论一个区间。世界模型预测的未来状态也可以是随机变量：相同观测和动作可能对应多个合理未来，模型应描述可能性，而不只输出一个平均状态。变量是物理量或数值映射，分布是关于它的不确定性描述，二者不是同一个对象。读 p(s′|s,a) 时，可以先翻译成“知道现在和动作后，下一步各种状态有多可能”。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。
nodes.symbols: X：随机变量；x：一次取值；p(x)：密度；∫：累积区间密度。
nodes.role: 直接基础：高层条件状态分布和扩散生成。
nodes.pitfall: 概率密度可以大于1；它本身不是某个精确值的概率。
nodes.quiz: 连续变量取一个精确值概率为0，是否代表这个值不可能被测到？
nodes.answer: 不是；精确点的概率和有限精度测量区间的概率不同。

notation.meaning: Random variable mapping outcomes to numeric values.
A possible realized value of X.
Probability density, when X has a density.

nodes.definition: A random variable maps outcomes of a random experiment to numerical values. Its distribution specifies probabilities of possible values or sets of values. A discrete variable uses probability masses; a continuous variable may have a probability density whose integral over an interval gives probability. Density values are not point probabilities and can exceed one. For a variable with a continuous density, any individual point has probability zero despite being a possible observation.
nodes.example: A die result is discrete, so \(P(X=3)=1/6\). A position sampled uniformly from \([0,0.5]\) has density \(p_X(x)=2\) within that interval. Its probability of lying between \(0.1\) and \(0.2\) is \(2(0.2-0.1)=0.2\). The density being two does not mean a probability exceeds one. Probabilities require integrating the density over an interval, and the total integral over its support is one.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM represents possible future states and diffusion noise using random vectors. Distinguishing densities from probabilities is necessary when reading Gaussian formulas, likelihood objectives, conditional distributions, and statements about low-density regions of the noise prior.

nodes.title: 条件概率与独立性
nodes.summary: 知道额外信息后重新描述不确定性。
nodes.explain:
不知道天气时你可能估计地面湿的概率；知道刚下过雨后，这个概率会变化。条件概率 P(A|B) 表示已知 B 成立时 A 的概率。机器人模型中的条件是当前状态和动作：同一机器人向左推、向右推，未来分布应该不同。独立意味着知道 B 不改变 A 的概率；“看上去无关”不等于已经证明独立。条件独立则必须说清在什么已知条件下成立。一个完整状态若概括了预测需要的历史，就可使用马尔可夫建模；这仍然是需要验证的建模假设。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: |：已知条件；P(A,B)：联合概率。
nodes.role: 直接基础：理解 p(sₜ₊₁|sₜ,aₜ) 及高层条件生成。
nodes.pitfall: P(A|B)通常不等于P(B|A)，独立性也不能随意假设。
nodes.quiz: 模型预测“执行某动作后到达目标的概率”，动作属于什么角色？
nodes.answer: 预测分布的条件之一。
nodes.latex: P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(B)},\quad P(B)>0;\qquad A\perp B\iff P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)

notation.meaning: Probability of A given that B occurred.
Joint probability that both events occur.

nodes.definition: Conditional probability restricts attention to outcomes compatible with known information and renormalizes their probability. The event being conditioned on must have positive probability in the elementary event formula. Independence means that knowing one event does not change the probability of the other. For continuous random variables, conditional densities require an appropriate density-based formulation; one should not divide point probabilities that are both zero.
nodes.example: For a fair die, let \(A\) mean an even result and \(B\) mean a result greater than three. Among the possible outcomes \(4,5,6\), two are even, so \(P(A\mid B)=2/3\). This differs from the unconditional \(P(A)=1/2\). Specifying additional information changes the distribution over the remaining possible outcomes. The conditioning event has probability one half, satisfying the positive-probability requirement of the formula.
nodes.role_en: The high-level model learns a future-state distribution conditioned on the current state and temporal interval. The low-level model additionally conditions its next-state prediction on state-action history. Conditional probability states exactly which information each predictor uses.

nodes.title: 贝叶斯公式
nodes.summary: 把先验知识与观测证据合在一起，得到后验判断。
nodes.explain:
假设机器人看到一个模糊圆形，先验可能认为它是球，也可能是灯。观察到它随推动滚动后，证据更支持球。贝叶斯公式把“某假设下出现证据的可能性”转换成“看到证据后假设的可能性”。先验是看证据前的判断，似然是每种假设对证据的解释，后验是更新后的结果。理解它有助于阅读状态估计、概率机器人学和生成模型推导。不过 ID-WM 的核心规划不是逐项实现一个贝叶斯滤波器；此处作为重要概率基础与机器人估计分支，不应强行标成每一步训练的直接计算。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。
nodes.symbols: H：假设；D：数据；先验P(H)；似然P(D|H)；后验P(H|D)。
nodes.role: 概率与机器人估计基础；不是 ID-WM 独立必需的算法模块。
nodes.pitfall: “似然大”不自动意味着后验大，还需考虑先验和其他解释。
nodes.quiz: 看到数据前的判断叫什么？
nodes.answer: 先验；结合数据更新后的判断叫后验。

notation.meaning: Likelihood of the evidence under the hypothesis.

nodes.definition: Bayes theorem relates a conditional probability to the reverse conditional probability, together with prior and evidence probabilities. The prior describes uncertainty before incorporating the specified evidence. The likelihood evaluates how compatible that evidence is with each hypothesis. The posterior is the normalized updated distribution. For continuous parameters, analogous formulas use densities and integrals. A likelihood viewed as a function of a parameter is not automatically a normalized probability distribution over that parameter.
nodes.example: Suppose \(P(H)=0.2\), \(P(D\mid H)=0.8\), and \(P(D\mid\neg H)=0.1\). The evidence probability is \(0.8(0.2)+0.1(0.8)=0.24\). The posterior is therefore \(0.16/0.24=2/3\). Observing the evidence increases the hypothesis probability, but the result depends on both the likelihood and the prior. If the evidence occurred equally often under both hypotheses, it would provide no change to the prior probability.
nodes.role_en: Bayesian reasoning is useful background for state estimation and probabilistic robotics. ID-WM uses conditional generative models and a Gaussian noise prior, but its core planner is not a Bayesian filter or a posterior-inference algorithm over robot states.
nodes.title_original: 贝叶斯公式：用证据更新判断

nodes.title: 期望
nodes.summary: 期望把随机结果的总体水平变成一个数。
nodes.explain:
若一次动作以0.8概率得十分，以0.2概率得零分，期望得分为八分。单次实验却不会出现八分，这说明期望不一定是能实际发生的结果。对大量独立同分布实验，样本平均可用来估计期望。训练损失常写成期望，因为我们关心模型对一类样本的平均表现，而不是记住某一条数据。实际计算只抽一小批样本，用平均损失近似整个分布上的期望。规划时也可能考虑平均代价，但平均会隐藏小概率的严重失败，因此实际机器人还需看尾部风险或约束。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: E：期望；N：样本数；x̄：样本均值。
nodes.role: 直接基础：扩散去噪目标、预测训练损失和实验平均指标。
nodes.pitfall: 期望不是最可能结果，也不保证某次实验达到该值。
nodes.quiz: 80%得10分、20%得0分，期望是多少？

notation.meaning: Mean of N observed or sampled values.

nodes.definition: Expectation is the probability-weighted average of a random variable, provided the relevant sum or integral exists. It is a property of a distribution. A sample mean is a statistic computed from finitely many observations and can approximate an expectation under suitable sampling conditions. Expected values need not be possible individual outcomes. Linearity allows expectations of sums to be added without requiring independence, although other manipulations may require stronger assumptions.
nodes.example: A fair die has expected value \((1+2+3+4+5+6)/6=3.5\), even though no roll equals \(3.5\). If observed rolls are \(1,6,2,3\), their sample mean is \(3\). This finite mean differs from the distribution expectation because it is based on only four samples. More samples do not guarantee monotonic improvement for each individual sample sequence.
nodes.role_en: The diffusion objective averages noise-prediction loss over sampled data, Gaussian noise, and diffusion indices. CEM also uses sample averages to refit candidate distributions. These operations connect probabilistic objectives with finite-batch computations in ID-WM.
nodes.title_original: 期望：按可能性加权的平均

nodes.title: 方差与协方差
nodes.summary: 方差衡量分散程度，协方差衡量两个量怎样一起变化。
nodes.explain:
两个模型平均误差都为一，不代表稳定性相同：一个每次都接近一，另一个有时为零、有时很大。方差刻画围绕均值的波动。二维位置数据可能沿斜线分布，水平坐标越大时竖直坐标也越大，协方差便为正。把所有分量两两的协方差排起来得到协方差矩阵。它既描述高斯分布椭圆的形状，也用于 PCA 找主方向。注意协方差受单位和尺度影响，相关系数才是归一化比较的一种方式。相关关系不能直接证明因果关系，机器人动作造成状态变化还需要相应实验设计。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: Var：方差；Cov：协方差；均值由 E 表示。
nodes.role: 直接基础：CEM 候选分布更新、高斯噪声；扩展支撑 PCA。
nodes.pitfall: 正相关不等于一个变量导致另一个变量。
nodes.quiz: 同样均值但波动更大的分布，哪个量通常更大？
nodes.answer: 方差。

notation.meaning: Mean squared deviation from the mean.
Covariance matrix for a random vector.

nodes.definition: Variance measures squared dispersion around a variable mean. Covariance measures whether deviations of two variables tend to have the same or opposite signs. For a random vector, collecting pairwise covariances gives a covariance matrix. Covariance depends on scale and units, and zero covariance does not generally imply independence. Estimating population covariance from samples also requires choosing an estimator and distinguishing population normalization from an unbiased sample estimate.
nodes.example: For a distribution assigning probability \(1/2\) to each of \(X=0\) and \(X=2\), the mean is \(1\), and the variance is \(((0-1)^2+(2-1)^2)/2=1\). If \(Y=2X\), covariance is \(2\). Increasing the units by a scale factor changes variance quadratically, which matters when combining differently scaled state features. For vector data, these pairwise calculations form a symmetric covariance matrix with nonnegative quadratic forms.
nodes.role_en: Gaussian distributions use variance or covariance to describe their spread. CEM refits these statistics from elite candidates, while diffusion schedules specify noise variances. Feature scaling also affects covariance-based analysis and learned-model numerical conditioning.

nodes.title: 高斯分布
nodes.summary: 用均值描述中心，用方差或协方差描述散布。
nodes.explain:
许多小扰动叠加时常出现钟形分布。均值 μ 决定中心，标准差 σ 决定宽窄；标准正态就是均值零、方差一。多元高斯描述一个向量的随机性：球的位置可以形成圆形或倾斜椭圆形的概率云。协方差为对角矩阵时，各方向的线性相关为零；对联合高斯，这还意味着分量独立。高斯便于采样和计算，但复杂未来可能有多个峰，例如绕障碍物左行或右行，单个高斯未必能表达。扩散把复杂数据与简单高斯噪声连接，CEM 常用高斯候选分布，但二者用途不同。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: ~：服从分布；μ：均值；σ：标准差；σ²：方差。
nodes.role: 直接基础：扩散加噪、去噪，以及 CEM 候选采样。
nodes.pitfall: 所有数据都近似高斯是假设，不能因为算法方便就当事实。
nodes.quiz: 均值2、标准差3，标准噪声取1，生成样本是多少？

notation.meaning: Multivariate standard normal with identity covariance.

nodes.definition: A Gaussian distribution is a continuous distribution specified in one dimension by a mean and positive variance. Its density decreases exponentially with squared distance from its mean after scaling by variance. A multivariate Gaussian replaces scalar variance with a covariance matrix, allowing correlations between coordinates. A standard multivariate Gaussian has zero mean and identity covariance. Its density describes local probability concentration, not the probability of an exact noise vector.
nodes.example: If \(\epsilon\) is standard normal, then \(X=2+3\epsilon\) has mean \(2\) and variance \(9\). A sampled \(\epsilon=0.5\) gives \(X=3.5\). In two dimensions, identity covariance gives independent standard-normal coordinates; a non-diagonal covariance can instead produce correlated candidate components, changing the geometry of the sampled distribution. The variance is nine rather than three because variance scales with the square of the multiplier.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM diffusion training adds Gaussian noise, and deterministic DDIM maps an initial Gaussian noise vector to a candidate future. CEM commonly samples parameterized Gaussian candidate distributions. Noise regularization discourages extreme coordinates but is not an exact physical-feasibility constraint.

nodes.title: 采样与蒙特卡洛估计
nodes.summary: 从分布抽有限个样本，近似难以完整计算的平均或搜索。
nodes.explain:
想估计一片不规则区域的面积，可以在外接矩形内均匀撒点，统计落在区域里的比例。蒙特卡洛就是利用样本近似总体量。规划时也可以随机尝试很多动作序列，比较预测结果，再集中采样好区域。随机种子决定伪随机数序列，便于重复实验，但固定一个种子并不证明算法稳定。样本数量越多通常估计越稳，却增加计算成本。若抽样分布从来不覆盖好方案，单纯加样本也可能无济于事。读 ID-WM 的噪声搜索与 CEM 时，要分清“从哪个分布抽什么”“每个样本如何评分”和“下一轮怎么更新”。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。
nodes.symbols: N：样本数；p：抽样分布；f：需要估计平均的函数。
nodes.role: 直接基础：CEM 与扩散噪声候选；实验复现也依赖种子记录。
nodes.pitfall: 固定随机种子保证某类重复性，不等于跨种子都表现良好。
nodes.quiz: 把样本平均当真实期望时，主要误差来自哪里？
nodes.answer: 有限样本带来的估计误差，也可能有采样偏差。

notation.meaning: Function whose expectation is being estimated.

nodes.definition: Sampling generates realizations from a specified distribution. Monte Carlo estimation approximates an expectation by averaging function values at sampled realizations. Under suitable independence and moment conditions, the sample average converges as the sample count grows, while finite estimates remain random. Pseudorandom generators use a seed to initialize a reproducible number sequence, but identical seeds alone do not ensure full reproducibility across changing devices, libraries, or nondeterministic operations.
nodes.example: To estimate the expected squared value of a standard-normal variable, sample values \(x_i\) and average \(x_i^2\). The true expectation is \(1\), but a small batch may differ substantially. In planning, sample candidates are scored rather than averaged into a single action. Increasing the candidate count increases computation and can improve search coverage without guaranteeing the global optimum.
nodes.role_en: Sampling appears in diffusion minibatches, Gaussian-noise initialization, and CEM candidate generation. It explains why ID-WM planning results depend on candidate counts and random seeds, and why search-budget comparisons should state the same sampling conditions.
nodes.title_original: 采样、随机种子与蒙特卡洛

nodes.title: 似然与最大似然估计
nodes.summary: 调整模型，让实际观察到的数据在模型中更可能出现。
nodes.explain:
假设一枚硬币的正面概率 θ 不知道，十次观察到七个正面。似然把 θ 当待调整旋钮，问这些已发生的数据在该 θ 下有多合理。最大似然会得到 θ=0.7。许多概率相乘容易变得非常小，取对数后乘法变加法，计算和求导更方便。负对数似然把“越大越好”变成机器学习常用的“损失越小越好”。若假设回归误差是方差固定的高斯噪声，最小化负对数似然会等价于最小化平方误差。这个联系解释了损失的由来，但损失选择仍依赖建模假设。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: argmax/argmin：取得最好值的参数；log：对数；i：样本索引。
nodes.role: 概率学习基础：连接数据拟合、回归损失与生成模型目标；ID-WM 扩散常用去噪损失训练。
nodes.pitfall: 似然是固定数据后关于参数的函数；不等于参数本身的概率分布。
nodes.quiz: 为何常把概率乘积改写为对数和？
nodes.answer: 防止数值下溢，并使优化更方便；最优参数不变。

notation.meaning: Observed data, treated as fixed during optimization.

nodes.definition: Likelihood evaluates a fixed observed dataset under different parameter settings of a probability model. Maximum likelihood chooses parameters giving the largest likelihood. With independent observations, the joint likelihood factors into a product, and taking its logarithm converts the product into a sum. Negative log-likelihood therefore gives an equivalent minimization objective. For continuous observations, the model terms are densities; they are not probabilities of the exact observed points.
nodes.example: Observe three successes and one failure from independent Bernoulli trials. A model with success probability \(p\) has likelihood \(p^3(1-p)\) for that ordered sequence. Maximizing it gives \(\hat p=3/4\). The fitted number is an estimate based on the data, not a guarantee that exactly three of the next four trials will succeed.
nodes.role_en: Likelihood gives probabilistic context for supervised losses, Gaussian modelling, and denoising objectives. ID-WM uses a noise-prediction diffusion objective and a state prediction loss; their reported forms should be read directly rather than replacing them with an unspecified generic likelihood.
nodes.title_original: 似然、最大似然与负对数似然

nodes.title: 熵与交叉熵
nodes.summary: 熵衡量分布的不确定性；交叉熵衡量用另一个分布编码真实结果的代价。
nodes.explain:
公平硬币的结果不好猜，永远正面的硬币没有不确定性，所以前者熵更高。熵是对 −log p 的期望；概率越低的意外结果，信息量越大。若真实类别是猫，分类器只给猫0.01概率，交叉熵惩罚会很大；给猫0.9则较小。它是分类学习的重要损失。熵不是预测误差的同义词：一个模型可以非常自信但完全错误。了解它有助于学习语言模型、分类和 KL 散度，但 ID-WM 的连续状态去噪主目标不是简单的类别交叉熵，应放在概率学习扩展与相关分支。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。
nodes.symbols: p：真实分布；q：模型分布；log底数影响单位。
nodes.role: 基础机器学习扩展：连接分类、KL 和生成模型理论；不把它说成 ID-WM 主损失。
nodes.pitfall: 输出更确定不代表更准确；低熵模型也可能系统性预测错。
nodes.quiz: 二分类真实标签为1，模型给该类概率越小，交叉熵怎样变化？
nodes.answer: 变大，因为 −log q 随 q 变小而增大。

notation.meaning: Cross-entropy of p relative to q.

nodes.definition: For a discrete distribution, entropy is the expected negative log probability under that distribution. Cross-entropy evaluates the expected negative log probability assigned by another distribution to the same outcomes. These definitions require suitable conventions for zero probabilities; assigning zero predicted probability to a possible reference outcome gives infinite cross-entropy. Logarithm base determines units. Continuous differential entropy is a different quantity and should not inherit every interpretation of discrete entropy.
nodes.example: For a fair binary distribution \(p=(0.5,0.5)\), entropy is \(\log 2\) with natural logarithms. If \(q=(0.9,0.1)\), cross-entropy is \(-0.5\log0.9-0.5\log0.1\), larger than \(\log2\). A confident but poorly matched prediction therefore has a worse expected log score than the correctly matched uncertain distribution. When the reference distribution itself is the prediction, cross-entropy equals entropy and the excess score vanishes.
nodes.role_en: Entropy is background for classification, distribution comparison, and the name of the Cross-Entropy Method. CEM planning itself can be understood operationally as sampling, selecting elites, and refitting a distribution; it is not a cross-entropy neural-network layer.

nodes.title: KL 散度
nodes.summary: 比较两个概率分布，并保留方向性。
nodes.explain:
一个模型把动物未来运动分成左转和右转，另一个几乎只允许直行；即使平均位置相近，它们表达的不确定性也可能差很多。KL 衡量真实分布 p 下，使用模型 q 比使用 p 多付出的平均对数代价。它非负，当分布一致时为零，但通常 KL(p||q) 与 KL(q||p) 不相等，因此不属于普通对称距离。若 p 认为某结果可能，q 却赋零概率，正向 KL 可能无穷大。扩散模型的概率推导会遇到 KL；第一遍实现去噪可以先理解条件采样和平方误差，再回到这条理论分支。

学习时先列出一个只有两三种结果的小实验，亲手检查概率是否归一、平均值如何得到，再模拟多次观察频率。这样能把公式和经验联系起来，也能分清一次随机结果、有限样本统计和总体分布三个层次。
nodes.symbols: ||：分布比较方向；D_KL：KL散度。
nodes.role: 扩散理论进阶基础；第一遍读 ID-WM 的算法主线时可以后补。
nodes.pitfall: KL 不是欧氏距离，通常不对称。
nodes.quiz: KL(p||q)=0 通常说明什么？
nodes.answer: 在相应概率意义下两分布一致。

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：概率与分布章节

notation.meaning: Directed divergence from p to q.
Separates distributions; it is not a vector norm.

nodes.definition: Kullback-Leibler divergence measures the expected log ratio between two distributions under the first distribution. It is nonnegative when defined and equals zero when the distributions agree almost everywhere. It is generally asymmetric and does not satisfy the triangle inequality, so it is not an ordinary distance metric. If the second distribution assigns zero probability where the first has positive probability, the divergence is infinite. Continuous versions replace sums with integrals.
nodes.example: For \(p=(0.5,0.5)\) and \(q=(0.9,0.1)\), compute \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\Vert q)=0.5\log(0.5/0.9)+0.5\log(0.5/0.1)\). Swapping the distributions changes both the weighting and ratios, so the answer differs. This direction dependence matters when comparing which distribution is expected to cover outcomes of the other. Neither result should be interpreted as a Euclidean separation between two state vectors; the inputs here are probability distributions over outcomes.
nodes.role_en: KL divergence helps interpret probabilistic modelling and variational or distribution-fitting methods. It is optional background for the main ID-WM planner: the paper noise regularizer is a coordinate-threshold penalty, not a KL divergence or exact Gaussian negative log-density.

nodes.title: 监督学习
nodes.summary: 从大量已知输入与正确输出的例子中学习规则。
nodes.explain:
给学生许多“问题—答案”，再让他处理没见过的问题，就是监督学习的直觉。预测机器人下一步时，输入可为当前状态和动作，目标是实际发生的下一步状态。数据集由许多这种配对组成，网络通过损失函数比较预测与目标。关键是部署时能否拿到相同类型的输入，以及训练数据是否覆盖将来遇到的状态。训练集答对只是记住示例的可能表现，还需要独立验证与测试。世界模型训练虽服务于控制，也包含明确的监督预测问题；“强化学习”和“监督学习”可以在同一系统不同环节出现。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: D：数据集；x：输入；y：目标；ŷ：预测。
nodes.role: 直接基础：低层状态预测与高层去噪器都从配对训练样本学习。
nodes.pitfall: 把未来目标信息意外塞进输入会造成数据泄漏。
nodes.quiz: 学习 (当前状态,动作)→下一状态，目标 y 是什么？
nodes.answer: 实际观察到的下一状态。

notation.meaning: Input and target for example i.

nodes.definition: Supervised learning fits a function using examples that pair inputs with target outputs. A loss measures disagreement between a prediction and its target, and training changes model parameters to reduce an empirical average of that loss. Targets need not be manually annotated: recorded future states can supply them. Performance on training pairs does not establish performance on unseen inputs, so evaluation must separate fitting from generalization.
nodes.example: Record a small vehicle state \((p_t,v_t)\), an action \(a_t\), and the next state \((p_{t+1},v_{t+1})\). Use the current state and action as input and the recorded next state as target. The model learns a transition mapping from many such examples. A shuffled or incorrectly time-aligned target would train a different, usually incorrect mapping.
nodes.role_en: The low-level ID-WM predictor uses supervised state-transition learning. The high-level denoiser also receives a supervised target, namely the sampled noise added to a future state, even though that target is constructed automatically rather than manually labelled.
nodes.title_original: 监督学习与输入目标对

nodes.title: 均方误差与经验风险
nodes.summary: 把每次预测偏差平方，再在数据上取平均。
nodes.explain:
预测下一步位置为三米，真实为五米，误差是负二，平方误差是四。平方避免正负相互抵消，也让大误差受到更强惩罚。对多维状态，常先对分量求平方和，再对样本平均，但实现时平均哪些维度必须写清。经验风险是有限训练样本上的平均损失；我们真正希望降低的是未来数据上的期望风险。若目标有多个相互矛盾的可能未来，平方误差倾向预测条件均值，均值未必是一个可行未来，例如绕墙左右两条路的中点恰好撞墙。这也是生成式未来建模有价值的原因。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.symbols: N：样本数；θ：参数；‖·‖₂²：平方误差和。
nodes.role: 直接基础：低层预测误差与扩散噪声回归目标。
nodes.pitfall: 均值预测可能落在不可能区域；低 MSE 不自动保证可用于规划。
nodes.quiz: 两个等可能目标是−1和1，最小平方误差的常数预测是什么？
nodes.answer: 0；但若只有两侧可行，0可能不是有效状态。

notation.meaning: Number of examples in the average.

nodes.definition: Mean squared error averages squared prediction errors over examples, sometimes also averaging over output coordinates depending on the convention. It is an empirical risk: a finite-data approximation to an expected loss. Squaring penalizes large residuals more strongly than absolute error and yields convenient derivatives. Its units are squared output units. Reporting a value requires stating which axes are averaged and whether dimensions are normalized or weighted.
nodes.example: Two scalar predictions have residuals \(1\) and \(3\). Their MSE is \((1^2+3^2)/2=5\), whereas the average absolute error is \(2\). For vector outputs, summing over coordinates before averaging over examples differs numerically from averaging over all entries. The difference is a fixed factor only when output dimensionality and weighting are fixed.
nodes.role_en: The high-level diffusion model uses a squared noise-prediction error. MSE also provides standard background for dynamics fitting, but the ID-WM paper writes its low-level prediction loss with an unsquared L2 norm; implementation and reporting should preserve that distinction.

nodes.title: 线性回归
nodes.summary: 先学习一个可解释的加权求和预测器。
nodes.explain:
假设推动时间越长，物体位移大致越大，可从位移≈速度×时间出发学习 y=wx+b。给许多时间和位移样本，调整斜率 w 与截距 b，使平方误差变小。多个输入时，每个输入有一个权重，例如当前速度和动作力都贡献下一位置。它结构简单、容易检查，是验证数据管线的良好基线。如果连一个简单线性模型都学不会，可能是单位、时间对齐或标签出了问题。真实接触动力学通常不能用一个全局线性函数完整描述，但局部线性近似仍然有用。神经网络线性层继承了这个加权求和步骤，再通过非线性组合增强表达能力。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: w：权重；b：偏置；x：输入；ŷ：预测。
nodes.role: 基础到深度学习的桥：可做动力学数据管线基线；非 ID-WM 必选模块。
nodes.pitfall: 更多数据不能让一个表达能力不足的全局线性模型拟合任意非线性。
nodes.quiz: y=2x+1 的斜率和截距各是多少？
nodes.answer: 斜率2，截距1。
nodes.latex: \hat y=\mathbf w^{\mathsf T}\mathbf x+b,\qquad\mathcal L=\frac1N\sum_i(\hat y_i-y_i)^2
nodes.definition: Linear regression predicts a numerical response using a weighted sum of features and an intercept. The prediction is affine in the input and linear in the fitted coefficients. Ordinary least squares chooses coefficients minimizing squared residuals. Nonlinear transformations may be included as predefined features, but the model remains linear in its coefficients. This provides a simple setting for understanding model fitting, loss gradients, feature scaling, and regularization before multilayer neural networks.
nodes.example: Suppose the model predicts distance from elapsed time using \(\hat y=2x+1\). At \(x=3\), its prediction is \(7\). If the measured target is \(8\), the residual is \(-1\) and its squared loss contribution is \(1\). Adding an input feature such as squared time changes the feature representation and can model acceleration within a linear-coefficient model.
nodes.role_en: Linear regression is a foundational supervised-learning example and a useful baseline for simple dynamics. ID-WM uses more expressive predictors, but the same separation of inputs, parameters, targets, and loss continues to apply.

nodes.title: 逻辑回归
nodes.summary: 先计算线性分数，再把它变成二分类概率。
nodes.explain:
预测一次推动是否成功，输出应在零与一之间。先计算分数 z=wᵀx+b，再经过 sigmoid 函数 σ(z)=1/(1+e^(−z))，得到成功概率。阈值0.5可用于最终判定，但它只是决策规则，概率训练与阈值选择不是同一件事。逻辑回归虽然名字有回归，常用于分类。它帮助理解神经元、概率输出和交叉熵损失；输入特征不变时，它的决策边界仍是线性的。ID-WM 主要预测连续状态与未来分布，不需要先实现逻辑回归才能运行；这条分支用来补全学习者已接触的基本分类知识。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: σ：sigmoid；z：实数分数；y：0/1标签。
nodes.role: 机器学习扩展：连接神经元、分类概率和损失；非 ID-WM 主线算法。
nodes.pitfall: 概率0.8不是“这个样本80%是半个成功”；它是对事件的不确定性预测。
nodes.quiz: z=0 时 sigmoid 输出多少？

notation.meaning: Sigmoid mapping to a probability in (0,1).

nodes.definition: Binary logistic regression models the conditional probability of one class by applying a sigmoid to an affine input score. It is usually trained with Bernoulli negative log-likelihood, equivalent to binary cross-entropy. A classification threshold converts probabilities into decisions and is distinct from fitting the probability model. Despite its name, logistic regression is commonly used for classification. Its confidence is not automatically calibrated on new distributions.
nodes.example: For a logit \(z=0\), the predicted class-one probability is \(0.5\). For \(z=\log3\), the probability is \(3/4\). A threshold of \(0.5\) classifies the latter as class one, while a threshold of \(0.9\) does not. Different error costs may justify different thresholds without retraining the underlying probability model. The output concerns conditional class probability, rather than a continuous position prediction or deterministic physical state transition.
nodes.role_en: Logistic regression connects linear models, conditional probabilities, sigmoid activations, and cross-entropy. It is a comparison and foundation branch, not a required component of ID-WM dynamics learning or its CEM planner.

nodes.title: 数据划分与数据泄漏
nodes.summary: 把用于学习、调参和最终报告的数据分开。
nodes.explain:
如果考试题提前用于练习，分数就不能衡量新题能力。训练集用于更新权重，验证集用于选超参数和停止时机，测试集用于最后独立评估。时间序列尤其危险：同一条视频里相邻两帧非常相似，把它们随机分到训练和测试会高估能力。机器人数据应按任务、轨迹、场景或物体划分，具体依据想验证什么泛化能力。归一化均值、PCA 等预处理也只能在训练部分拟合，再应用到其他部分。离线数据多并不自动解决泄漏，需要记录每一条样本的来源。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.formula: D=Dtrain ⊔ Dval ⊔ Dtest；预处理参数仅由 Dtrain 拟合
nodes.symbols: ⊔：不重叠并集；train：训练；val：验证；test：测试。
nodes.role: 直接工程基础：可信地评估 ID-WM 预测、规划与新布局泛化。
nodes.pitfall: 随机拆分帧不一定是独立测试；反复依据测试集调参也构成泄漏。
nodes.quiz: 同一轨迹相邻帧被随机拆到训练和测试，有什么风险？
nodes.answer: 模型利用高度相似样本获得虚高指标，不能证明新轨迹泛化。

notation.meaning: Data used to fit model parameters and preprocessing statistics.
Data used for model and hyperparameter selection.
Held-out data used for final evaluation.

nodes.definition: A data split assigns different examples or groups to training, validation, and test roles. The test set should not influence parameter fitting, preprocessing, or repeated model-selection decisions. Leakage occurs when information unavailable in the intended deployment setting enters these processes. Sequential data require particular care because neighboring frames are correlated. Disjoint frame indices are insufficient when nearly identical frames or future information from the same trajectory appear across split boundaries.
nodes.example: Take ten recorded episodes. Assign six complete episodes to training, two to validation, and two to testing, then create temporal windows within each partition. Computing normalization statistics on all ten episodes would still leak test information. Likewise, making a transition pair from the last frame of one episode and first frame of another would create an artificial state jump.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM learns from offline trajectories, so correct episode boundaries and future-state alignment are essential. Data splitting supports honest tests of generalization to held-out trajectories or goal configurations and prevents an apparently accurate predictor from benefiting from leaked future observations.
nodes.title_original: 训练、验证、测试与轨迹泄漏

nodes.title: 偏差、方差与泛化
nodes.summary: 模型既可能太简单学不够，也可能把训练噪声记得太牢。
nodes.explain:
用直线拟合明显弯曲的数据，训练与验证误差都可能很高，这是欠拟合。用高次曲线穿过每个带噪声的训练点，训练误差极低、验证误差却升高，这是过拟合。偏差描述系统性近似误差，方差描述换一批训练数据时模型有多容易改变。严格的偏差方差分解依赖具体损失和假设，不能把它当所有深度学习曲线的唯一解释。世界模型还有更特殊的情况：单步误差不错，但规划器反复寻找模型弱点，导致真实执行失败。需要同时看训练验证曲线、长步预测及闭环任务效果。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.formula: 平方误差下：期望预测误差=偏差²+方差+不可约噪声
nodes.symbols: 偏差：平均预测偏离真值；方差：跨训练集预测波动。
nodes.role: 直接工程基础：选容量、检查泛化；连接世界模型被规划器利用的误差。
nodes.pitfall: 训练误差很低不能证明模型适合闭环规划。
nodes.quiz: 训练很准、验证很差，更像哪种现象？
nodes.answer: 过拟合或数据分布不一致，需要进一步诊断。
nodes.latex: \mathbb E_{\mathcal D,\varepsilon}\!\left[(\hat f_{\mathcal D}(x)-Y)^2\right]=\operatorname{Bias}(x)^2+\operatorname{Var}_{\mathcal D}[\hat f_{\mathcal D}(x)]+\sigma_\varepsilon^2

notation.meaning: Predictor fitted on random training dataset D.
Difference between the mean fitted prediction and f*(x).
Irreducible observation-noise variance under the stated model.

nodes.definition: The bias-variance decomposition describes expected squared prediction error under a specified data-generating model. Bias measures how the average fitted predictor differs from the true conditional mean. Variance measures how fitted predictions change across random training datasets. Noise is the response variation not explained by the input under that model. Underfitting and overfitting are practical patterns, not quantities fully determined by one loss curve or a universal statement that larger models always generalize worse.
nodes.example: Fit a straight line to many small datasets sampled from a strongly curved function. The average line may systematically miss the curve, indicating bias. Fit a highly flexible model that changes greatly whenever the small dataset changes, and prediction variance may be large. Repeated training datasets are the conceptual comparison; merely inspecting different examples within one fixed test set does not isolate this variance term.
nodes.role_en: Generalization determines whether ID-WM predictions remain useful for planner-generated state-action combinations. This node motivates held-out evaluation and regularization, but the decomposition alone cannot predict closed-loop success or guarantee reliability under distribution shift.
nodes.title_original: 欠拟合、过拟合与偏差方差

nodes.title: 正则化与权重衰减
nodes.summary: 在拟合数据之外，加入对模型复杂度或行为的偏好。
nodes.explain:
如果很多曲线都能解释训练数据，可以偏好较平滑或参数较小的那一类。L2 正则在损失后加 λ‖θ‖²，使过大权重付出额外代价。λ 太大可能压制有用规律，太小可能不足以约束过拟合。早停、数据增强等也能产生正则化效果，但机制不同。对普通梯度下降，L2 惩罚可写成一种参数缩小更新；对带自适应缩放的优化器，耦合 L2 与 AdamW 的解耦权重衰减不应直接当同一件事。ID-WM 还使用高层噪声正则，这是对规划候选的限制，与训练网络的权重正则作用对象不同。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: λ：正则强度；θ：模型权重；Ldata：数据拟合损失。
nodes.role: 直接工程基础；帮助区分网络正则与 ID-WM 规划噪声正则。
nodes.pitfall: 同叫正则化，也要看约束的是网络权重、动作还是规划噪声。
nodes.quiz: λ过大可能带来什么问题？
nodes.answer: 模型受限过强而欠拟合。
nodes.definition: Regularization adds preferences or restrictions to an optimization problem to improve statistical or numerical behavior. An L2 parameter penalty discourages large weights relative to the data-fitting objective. It changes the optimization target and must be selected using an appropriate validation process. Weight decay can coincide with L2 regularization for some update rules, but decoupled weight decay in adaptive optimizers is not generally identical to adding that penalty to the loss.
nodes.example: Consider \(\mathcal L(w)=(w-2)^2+\lambda w^2\). Setting the derivative to zero gives \(w=2/(1+\lambda)\). With \(\lambda=0\), the optimum is \(2\); with \(\lambda=1\), it is \(1\). The penalized solution accepts more data residual in exchange for a smaller coefficient. Whether this helps new examples must be measured. This trade-off depends on the scale of the data loss and cannot be chosen independently of normalization conventions.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM training can use regularized optimizers, while high-level planning uses a separate noise-coordinate penalty. Both modify an objective, but they penalize different variables: learned weights during training versus searched noise decisions during inference.

nodes.title: 标准化与数值尺度
nodes.summary: 让不同量级的特征进入可比较的数值范围。
nodes.explain:
机器人位置可能在数米内，角度在几弧度内，图像像素在0到255；直接拼接时，大数值分量可能主导误差与优化。标准化先减训练均值，再除训练标准差，使每一维大致围绕零、尺度接近一。它没有消除物理意义，只改变数值表达；模型输出要正确反变换。均值和标准差必须由训练集计算，部署时保持一致。若标准差接近零，需要稳定常数或特殊处理。还要区分数据标准化与神经网络内的 LayerNorm：它们处理的维度、时机和统计方式不同，不能只因为名字相近就混用。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: μtrain、σtrain：训练数据统计；ε：稳定常数。
nodes.role: 直接工程基础：状态、动作、距离和网络训练的尺度一致性。
nodes.pitfall: 不能用测试集统计来拟合归一化；输出忘记还原单位会出错。
nodes.quiz: 为何不应先用全部数据计算均值再划分测试集？
nodes.answer: 测试分布信息泄漏进了预处理。

notation.meaning: Feature mean and standard deviation fitted on training data.

nodes.definition: Standardization centers a numerical feature and scales it using a reference standard deviation. Statistics should be fitted on training data and reused unchanged on validation, testing, and inference inputs. This operation can improve conditioning and prevent differently scaled features from dominating an unweighted loss. It does not make a non-Gaussian distribution Gaussian. Features with physical limits, periodic angles, or very small variance may require more specific preprocessing choices.
nodes.example: If training positions have mean \(10\) metres and standard deviation \(2\) metres, a position of \(14\) metres becomes approximately \(2\) after standardization. A predicted standardized value of \(-1\) converts back to approximately \(8\) metres. Using different test-set statistics would change the representation and expose information from the evaluation data. The same stored training statistics must be used when transforming future goals and predicted states.
nodes.role_en: Consistent feature scaling matters for dynamics losses, state distances, Gaussian modelling, and optimization. Any ID-WM implementation that standardizes states must apply the same transformation to current states, future targets, and goals, and invert it when physical interpretation is required.
nodes.title_original: 标准化、尺度与数值稳定

nodes.title: 主成分分析
nodes.summary: 用较少线性坐标保留数据中最大的方差。
nodes.explain:
一群点沿斜线分布，分别记录横纵坐标需要两个数，但沿斜线的位置可能已经解释大部分变化。PCA 先中心化数据，计算协方差矩阵，再取最大特征值对应的方向作为第一主成分；后续方向彼此正交。把数据投影到前 k 个方向，就得到线性低维表示。最大方差未必等于对任务最重要：背景亮度变化可能大，物体小位移却决定是否成功。因此 PCA 是解释降维和表示学习的好起点，但不等于 DINO 或神经网络学到的特征。拟合 PCA 时也必须只用训练数据，避免测试信息泄漏。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.formula: z=Wₖᵀ(x−μ)；Wₖ 的列是协方差最大的 k 个特征方向
nodes.symbols: z：低维坐标；Wₖ：主方向矩阵；μ：训练均值。
nodes.role: 机器学习扩展：理解表示、降维和信息丢失；ID-WM 不等于先执行 PCA。
nodes.pitfall: 最大方差方向未必是控制任务最有用的方向。
nodes.quiz: 若最显著变化是背景灯光，PCA 第一主成分一定利于机器人控制吗？
nodes.answer: 不一定；任务相关性与方差大小不同。

notation.meaning: Matrix containing the top k orthonormal covariance eigenvectors.

nodes.definition: Principal component analysis finds orthogonal directions capturing the greatest variance in centered data. Projecting onto the leading directions gives a linear lower-dimensional representation and minimizes squared linear reconstruction error under the usual orthonormal formulation. The result depends on feature scaling and the data used to estimate the mean and covariance. High variance is not necessarily task relevance, and PCA does not use labels or directly optimize planning success.
nodes.example: If a centered two-dimensional dataset has covariance \(\operatorname{diag}(9,1)\), retaining the horizontal eigenvector keeps variance \(9\) out of total variance \(10\). A sample \([2,3]^{\mathsf T}\) projects to the one-dimensional coordinate \(2\), and its rank-one reconstruction is \([2,0]^{\mathsf T}\). The discarded vertical variation may still matter for a downstream task. Keeping the largest variance direction therefore solves a reconstruction objective, not automatically the task objective.
nodes.role_en: PCA offers a concrete comparison for learned representations and latent dimensionality. ID-WM visual features follow neural representation-learning methods rather than PCA. PCA may support diagnostics or preprocessing, but it is not a mandatory predecessor of DINO or clustering.
nodes.title_original: PCA：沿最有变化的方向压缩

nodes.title: 聚类与高斯混合模型
nodes.summary: 没有标签时，按结构组织数据；多个高斯可以表达多个模式。
nodes.explain:
观察推动后的位置可能形成两团：从障碍左边绕过，或从右边绕过。K-means 给每团一个中心，把点分给最近中心，并反复更新均值。高斯混合进一步给每团一个概率分布和混合权重，使边界可以是软分配。它们帮助理解“多模态未来”：一个全局平均可能恰好落在墙里，多个模式可以保留不同可行选择。聚类结果仍取决于距离、尺度和簇数，不能自动当成真实因果类别。ID-WM 使用扩散表达可达未来，不要求先做 K-means 或 GMM；此分支作为生成分布的对照。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: πₖ：混合权重；μₖ：中心；Σₖ：协方差；k：分量。
nodes.role: 扩展：解释单峰与多峰、可达状态分布；不是 ID-WM 必选前处理。
nodes.pitfall: 聚出来的两类可能来自照明差异，不能自动解释成两种技能。
nodes.quiz: 左右绕墙是两个模式，单个均值预测可能有什么问题？
nodes.answer: 均值可能位于不可通行的墙内。
nodes.definition: Clustering organizes unlabeled observations according to a chosen similarity or probabilistic model. K-means minimizes within-cluster squared Euclidean distances to cluster centers, producing hard assignments in its basic form. A Gaussian mixture instead models a density as a weighted sum of Gaussian components and can give probabilistic component assignments. These methods make different assumptions. Their clusters need not correspond to semantic categories, and PCA preprocessing is optional rather than mathematically required.
nodes.example: Imagine future object positions concentrated near two doorways. A single Gaussian centered between them may assign substantial density to an intervening obstacle, while two Gaussian components can represent both concentrations separately. A mixture with equal weights and means \(-2\) and \(2\) illustrates this multimodality. Fitting it successfully still does not establish that every sampled position is dynamically reachable.
nodes.role_en: Mixture models explain why future-state distributions can have multiple modes and why predicting only a mean can be inadequate. ID-WM uses a conditional diffusion model for high-level futures; it does not require fitting a Gaussian mixture as part of the method.

nodes.title: 评估指标与不确定性
nodes.summary: 用符合任务的问题评估模型，并报告样本波动。
nodes.explain:
世界模型至少有两类评估：预测是否接近真实，以及规划后是否真的完成任务。模型可以单步误差小却长期累积漂移，也可以平均误差略大但关键接触更可靠。因此需要单步、多步、闭环成功率、执行步数和计算成本等不同视角。十次成功九次与一千次成功九百次虽然成功率相同，估计把握不同；可用重复种子、区间和分任务统计表达波动。失败视频能显示平均数藏住的问题，例如绕墙时穿墙或接触时突跳。评价标准、阈值、终止条件和测试分布必须一起记录。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。每次继续前，可用下面的检查题确认具体计算与概念是否一致。
nodes.formula: 成功率=k/N；独立伯努利近似标准误≈√[p̂(1−p̂)/N]
nodes.symbols: k：成功次数；N：试验数；p̂：经验成功率；近似需足够样本。
nodes.role: 直接工程基础：理解 ID-WM 表格与复现实验，防止把预测指标当执行成功。
nodes.pitfall: 只报告最好种子、只选成功视频、只比较不同硬件总耗时都会误导。
nodes.quiz: 单步 MSE 更低，是否一定闭环成功率更高？
nodes.answer: 不一定；误差位置、累积、规划器行为与任务约束都影响执行。

notation.meaning: Approximate standard error under independent Bernoulli trials.

nodes.definition: Evaluation measures model or algorithm performance using metrics matched to the intended task and a specified test distribution. Prediction error, task success, completion time, and computation cost answer different questions. A finite test result has sampling uncertainty; approximate Bernoulli standard error assumes suitably independent trials and can be poor near probability boundaries or for small samples. Failures, repeated seeds, and consistent success definitions are necessary for interpreting aggregate scores.
nodes.example: If \(80\) of \(100\) independent trials succeed, \(\hat p=0.8\), and the approximate standard error is \(0.04\). This is not a guarantee that the true success probability lies in any particular interval, and repeated nearly identical trials may not behave as independent samples. Report the tested initial-goal distribution alongside the rate so the result has a clear scope.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM reports task success and manipulation coverage under specified environments and budgets. Evaluation should distinguish model prediction from executed closed-loop success and compare methods using matched data, goals, search budgets, and timing definitions whenever possible.
nodes.title_original: 指标、置信度与失败分析

nodes.title: 分布偏移与多步误差
nodes.summary: 模型生成的新状态可能逐渐离开训练数据覆盖范围。
nodes.explain:
模型在真实状态上预测下一步很好，不代表把自己的预测不断当输入后仍然准确。第一步小偏差让第二步输入变化，第二步又在偏离的数据上继续预测，于是误差可能滚大。控制任务里还会出现策略分布变化：规划器选择的动作不同于收集训练数据的动作，模型被问到没见过的问题。解决方向包括多步训练、更多覆盖、闭环重新观测、限制规划范围、层级分解和不确定性处理，但每种都有条件。ID-WM 的层级设计就是围绕长时域规划的累计误差和搜索困难展开，理解这个节点才能看清方法动机。

实践时先在一份小的合成数据上实现并画出结果，再与可靠库函数核对；保留数据划分、随机种子和单位。检查错误例子比只看一个总分更有帮助，也能判断问题来自数据、模型假设、训练过程还是评价方式。
nodes.symbols: s：真实状态；ŝ：预测状态；t：时间步。
nodes.role: ID-WM 核心动机：长时域低层滚动预测与搜索会放大模型误差。
nodes.pitfall: “离线训练指标很好”不能证明模型生成的状态仍在可信区域。
nodes.quiz: 为何只在真实输入上测单步误差还不够？
nodes.answer: 实际规划会反复使用模型预测作输入，产生新的输入分布与累计偏差。

notation.meaning: Predicted state used recursively in a rollout.

nodes.definition: Distribution shift occurs when the data encountered in evaluation or deployment differ from the training distribution. A learned dynamics model can also encounter its own imperfect predicted states during recursive rollout, creating inputs unlike recorded training states. Planning compounds this issue because optimization actively selects candidate actions or latent decisions according to model predictions. Small average training error therefore does not bound errors at the particular states selected by an optimizer.
nodes.example: A model trained only on slow forward vehicle motion may predict backward or high-speed motion poorly. A planner can nevertheless choose those inputs if erroneous predictions make them appear to reach the goal quickly. Even using familiar actions can move predicted states progressively away from recorded trajectories. Test both single-step errors on held-out data and multi-step, executed task performance.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM addresses long-horizon planning through hierarchy and regularizes high-level noise to discourage extreme searched inputs. These measures reduce particular failure modes but do not guarantee correctness for unseen environments, unsupported contacts, or arbitrary out-of-distribution goals.

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：数学基础教材

nodes.title: 指数与对数
nodes.summary: 指数表示连乘与增长，对数把乘法关系转换为加法关系。
nodes.explain:
若一个量每一步翻倍，经过三步就乘以2³；指数把重复相乘写紧凑。对数反过来问“要乘多少次”：log₂8=3。机器学习常用自然指数 exp(x)=eˣ 和自然对数 ln(x)，二者互为反函数。对数最关键的性质是 log(ab)=log a+log b，因此一大串概率相乘，可以变成对数概率相加。概率往往很小，直接连乘容易超出计算机精度，改用对数既稳定也便于优化。log 在正数范围单调增加，所以最大化概率与最大化其对数取得相同的最优参数。

例如公平硬币连续十次都正面的概率是(1/2)¹⁰，对数概率则是10log(1/2)。要区分 log概率 与负log概率：前者越大越好，后者通常作为损失越小越好。计算时还要注意 log(0) 没有有限值，模型不能随意给真实可能事件零概率。
nodes.symbols: exp：自然指数；ln：自然对数；e：自然常数约2.718。
nodes.role: 直接概率学习基础：似然、交叉熵与KL；也帮助读扩散噪声日程。
nodes.pitfall: 对数底数影响单位；log(0)没有有限值。
nodes.quiz: log₂8等于多少？

notation.meaning: Natural logarithm unless a different base is specified.
Positive arguments required for the displayed real logarithms.

nodes.definition: The exponential function maps real inputs to positive values, and the natural logarithm is its inverse on positive inputs. Logarithms convert products into sums and powers into scalar multiples, which simplifies probability calculations and optimization. Exponentials appear in Gaussian densities and probability-normalization functions such as softmax. Numerical implementations must avoid overflow, underflow, and logarithms of zero; algebraically equivalent formulas can differ greatly in floating-point stability.
nodes.example: The product \(0.1\times0.2\) is \(0.02\), and its log equals \(\log0.1+\log0.2\). A likelihood containing thousands of small probabilities may underflow when multiplied directly, while summing their logarithms is more manageable. For softmax, subtracting the largest input score before exponentiation preserves the normalized output and reduces overflow risk. A mathematically valid calculation still needs a numerically stable implementation in finite precision.
nodes.role_en: Exponentials and logarithms support Gaussian noise models, likelihood, entropy, and softmax attention. They are foundational for reading diffusion and Transformer equations even though the planner itself can be implemented using sampled candidates and scalar scores.

sources.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning：数学基础教材

nodes.title: 求和与索引
nodes.summary: 用紧凑符号描述对许多元素反复执行同一操作。
nodes.explain:
Σ 看起来像一个复杂符号，实际只是把许多项加起来。Σᵢ₌₁³xᵢ 表示 x₁+x₂+x₃，下标 i 是遍历元素的位置，不是一个新的物理量。假如三个误差为1、−2、3，平方误差和就是1²+(−2)²+3²=14。把这个和再除以三，就得到每个样本的平均平方误差。数学论文常同时沿时间、样本、特征维度求和，必须先问每个索引遍历什么，再看求和后保留哪些维度。

例如一批B条轨迹、每条T步、每步d维状态，可以先对d个状态误差求和，再对B和T平均。代码里的sum与mean对应不同归约；有时只差固定倍率，有时还影响样本权重。建议先把Σ完全展开成两三项，核对含义后再接受紧凑写法。这样读矩阵乘法、期望和训练损失时，都能看清反复计算的具体内容。
nodes.symbols: Σ：求和；i：索引；N：项数；x_N：第N项。
nodes.role: 直接基础：矩阵乘法、平均损失、轨迹代价与注意力加权和。
nodes.pitfall: 必须分清按特征求和和按样本平均；索引不是指数。
nodes.quiz: Σᵢ₌₁³ i²是多少？

notation.meaning: Arithmetic mean of the indexed values.

nodes.definition: Summation notation expresses repeated addition over an explicitly specified index set. An index identifies a position rather than introducing another measured physical quantity. Its range must be clear, particularly when batch, time, feature, and diffusion-step indices coexist. A mean divides the relevant sum by the number of included terms. Nested sums can average different axes, and those choices change a reported loss or statistic unless the normalization convention is held fixed.
nodes.example: For values \(x_1=2\), \(x_2=4\), and \(x_3=9\), the sum is \(15\) and the mean is \(5\). In a dataset with two examples and three output coordinates each, summing all squared residuals and dividing by two produces a mean per example; dividing by six produces a mean per scalar coordinate. State which version is intended.
nodes.role_en: Sums and averages occur in minibatch losses, covariance estimates, attention-weighted combinations, CEM distribution updates, and noise regularization. Keeping index meanings distinct prevents confusion between environment time, diffusion steps, model dimensions, and sampled planning candidates.

nodes.title: 张量与形状
nodes.summary: 给每个数字标清它属于哪个样本、时刻和维度。
nodes.explain:
把一张成绩表理解为“学生×科目”的矩阵。再收集一学期的成绩，就多出“月份”这一轴；这种按若干轴排列的数字容器叫张量。机器人数据也一样：32段录像、每段10步、每步6个状态量，可写成形状(32,10,6)。它表示组织方式，并不说明这些量在物理上相乘。读网络代码时先逐轴说出含义，再看运算怎样改变形状。比如线性层只把最后一轴从6维变成64维，前面的样本轴、时间轴可以保持。批处理是在一遍计算中处理多条数据，方便GPU并行，不能把不同轨迹混成一条时间序列。能画出每层输入输出形状，是调试世界模型最先要练的技能。

动手时先生成全零的假数据，给每个轴加上注释，经过每个模块打印shape。再把批量从1改为7、历史从3改为5，观察是否仍能运行。若代码只在固定批量下成功，往往存在错误的reshape。数字总数相同也不能证明维度语义正确。
nodes.symbols: B：批量大小；T：历史长度；d：每步状态维度；h：隐藏宽度；W形状d×h。
nodes.role: ID-WM低层接收状态和动作历史；理解时间轴与特征轴才能检查Transformer输入。
nodes.pitfall: 张量阶数、矩阵秩和网络层数是不同概念。
nodes.quiz: (8,5,12)经最后一轴12→64线性层后是什么形状？
nodes.latex: X\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times T\times d},\quad W\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times h},\quad Y=XW+b\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times T\times h}

notation.meaning: Number of sequences in a batch.
Number of time steps per sequence.

nodes.definition: A tensor is an array indexed along a specified number of axes. Its shape records the length of each axis; the interpretation of an axis is part of the data definition. In sequence learning, batch, time, and feature axes have different meanings even when two axes happen to have the same length. A linear layer can act on the final feature axis while preserving the batch and time axes. Broadcasting, reshaping, and transposition change how values participate in operations and must be checked explicitly.
nodes.example: A batch of eight trajectory windows, each containing five observations with six state features, has shape \(8\times5\times6\). Multiplying its last axis by a weight matrix of shape \(6\times16\) gives an output of shape \(8\times5\times16\). Exchanging the time and feature axes changes the modeled operation; it does not merely rename two dimensions. Write down the meaning of all three axes before using a Transformer.
nodes.role_en: ID-WM conditions its low-level predictor on a history of states and actions. Tensor shapes specify which entries belong to a trajectory, time step, state feature, or action embedding, and make input-label alignment errors visible.

nodes.title: 全连接层与仿射变换
nodes.summary: 把输入各分量按权重混合，得到新的特征。
nodes.explain:
假设根据位置x和速度v估计下一刻位置，最简单的计算是w₁x+w₂v+b。全连接层把这条计算同时做很多遍，每个输出单元有自己的一组权重，于是输出可以从2个数变成64个数。矩阵只是把这64条加权求和紧凑地写在一起。“全连接”表示每个输出可以读取所有输入维度；“仿射”提醒我们还加了偏置。它很灵活，但单独堆很多仿射层仍可合并成一个仿射变换，因此还需要激活函数。实现时应数清参数：输入d维、输出h维，就有dh个权重和h个偏置。这也解释为什么只知道“三层网络”无法判断模型大小。

例如x=[2,3]，一个输出的权重为[4,−1]，偏置为1，结果就是4×2−3+1=6。把这个例子用纸笔、NumPy和PyTorch各算一遍，再推广到一批输入。这种可手算的小例子比直接调试上百万参数更容易发现矩阵转置错误。
nodes.symbols: x∈ℝᵈ；W∈ℝ^(h×d)；b,y∈ℝʰ。
nodes.role: ID-WM用MLP把原始动作编码为适合Transformer处理的表示。
nodes.pitfall: 把隐藏宽度当成层数；忽略偏置和矩阵方向。
nodes.quiz: 输入4维、输出8维的仿射层多少参数？

notation.meaning: Trainable weight matrix and bias vector.

nodes.definition: An affine layer forms each output as a weighted sum of all input components plus a bias. The weight matrix defines a linear transformation; the bias allows a nonzero output at zero input. A fully connected layer is dense because every output can depend on every input component. Composing affine layers without nonlinear activations still produces one affine transformation. Feature dimensions and vector orientation determine whether a code implementation multiplies by a matrix or its transpose.
nodes.example: Let \(x=(2,3)^\top\), \(W=(4,-1)\), and \(b=2\). The scalar output is \(4\cdot2-3+2=7\). A layer with two input features and three outputs has six weights and three biases. Applying the same learned layer at every time step changes feature coordinates consistently across the sequence; it does not yet mix information between time steps.
nodes.role_en: The low-level ID-WM action encoder uses an MLP built from affine layers and nonlinearities. Attention projections and feed-forward sublayers also use affine transformations to produce compatible feature dimensions. These projections are learned from offline data.

nodes.title: 激活函数与非线性
nodes.summary: 让网络可以表达转弯、阈值和复杂曲线。
nodes.explain:
用直线预测“推力越大移动越远”容易，但推动物体时，力太小可能完全不动，超过静摩擦阈值才开始滑。这类弯折关系需要非线性。ReLU对负输入输出0，对正输入保持原值；它像一道可由输入打开的门。把仿射层与这道门组合，就能拼出许多折线片段，进一步近似复杂关系。激活函数并不自动给网络物理知识，阈值和形状仍需由数据学出。训练还要考虑导数：某些函数在很大或很小输入处接近饱和，梯度会很小。理解激活函数时最好自己画函数和斜率，而不是仅记名字。输出层是否使用激活则取决于任务，预测无界速度一般不能随意套sigmoid。

可以把x从−2取到2，逐点画出ReLU曲线，再把输入先乘负数，观察折线方向如何改变。注意在0这个折点的导数需由实现约定处理；这不会让整套训练失效，但提醒我们神经网络常是几乎处处可微，而不是每一点都光滑。
nodes.symbols: x：某单元的加权输入；ReLU正半轴导数1、负半轴0。
nodes.role: 让动力学预测器与去噪器能表达非线性的状态转移。
nodes.pitfall: 每一层都必须用同一激活函数；连续状态输出必须压到0到1。
nodes.quiz: 若连续两层都是纯仿射变换，为何表达能力仍是仿射？
nodes.answer: 展开W₂(W₁x+b₁)+b₂可合并成一个矩阵和偏置。

notation.meaning: A scalar pre-activation; vector inputs are usually processed elementwise.

nodes.definition: An activation function transforms a layer output, usually component by component. A nonlinear activation allows a composition of layers to represent functions that cannot be reduced to one affine transformation. The function also determines local derivatives used during training. ReLU is zero for negative inputs and linear for positive inputs; sigmoid maps real inputs into the interval between zero and one. The choice affects approximation, gradient propagation, numerical behavior, and the interpretation of outputs.
nodes.example: For inputs \((-2,0,3)\), ReLU returns \((0,0,3)\). Sigmoid maps zero to \(1/2\), but this value is a probability only when a modeling objective gives it that interpretation. Combining affine layers with nonlinear activations can approximate a transition with different behavior before and after contact, although successful learning still requires suitable data and training.
